name: Fox ESS Solar Battery
tagline: A 10.36 kWh high-voltage lithium iron phosphate home battery.
summary: The Fox ESS EP11 is a high-voltage lithium iron phosphate battery with its own battery management system, made for homes with solar.
It stores surplus solar during the day for use at night, and can provide standby power. Units can be used singly or in parallel.

image.alt: Fox ESS Solar Battery home battery unit

highlights.title: LFP chemistry
highlights.text: Uses lithium iron phosphate cells with a customised battery management system.

highlights.title: Multiple protections
highlights.text: Guards against short circuit, over-voltage, over-current, over-temperature and under-voltage.

highlights.title: Modular and scalable
highlights.text: Run a single battery or connect several in parallel as your needs grow.

highlights.title: App monitoring
highlights.text: Remote monitoring is available through the inverter app.

highlights.title: IP65 protection
highlights.text: The EP11 carries an IP65 ingress protection rating.
